    def test_export_with_quotes_and_equals(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            parse_dotenv_line('export PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT="https://x.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live"'),

        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line("KEY='a=b=c'"), ("KEY", "a=b=c"))

    def test_quoted_value_with_trailing_comment(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line('KEY="v" # note'), ("KEY", "v"))

    def test_unquoted_value_is_stripped(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line("  KEY =  value  "), ("KEY", "value"))

    def test_comments_and_blank_lines_ignored(self):
        self.assertIsNone(parse_dotenv_line("# comment"))
        self.assertIsNone(parse_dotenv_line(""))
        self.assertIsNone(parse_dotenv_line("   "))

        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line("exportX=1"), ("exportX", "1"))

        path = write_env(
            "# header\n"
            "export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN=\"sk_test_1=2\"\n"
            "PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET='whsec_x'\n"
            "export PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT=https://e.example/?a=1&b=2\n"
            "PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=15\n"
        )
        try:
            config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=path)

        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET"], ("whsec_x", ".env"))
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"], ("https://e.example/?a=1&b=2", ".env"))

            'export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sk_live_SECRETVALUE123"\n'

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from payhook.config import load_config, parse_dotenv_line
from payhook.doctor import doctor_report

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def write_env(text):
    handle, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".env")
    with os.fdopen(handle, "w") as f:
        f.write(text)
    return path


class DotenvParsingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_export_with_quotes_and_equals(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            parse_dotenv_line('export PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT="https://x.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live"'),
            ("PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT", "https://x.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live"),
        )

    def test_single_quotes_with_equals(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line("KEY='a=b=c'"), ("KEY", "a=b=c"))

    def test_quoted_value_with_trailing_comment(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line('KEY="v" # note'), ("KEY", "v"))

    def test_unquoted_value_is_stripped(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line("  KEY =  value  "), ("KEY", "value"))

    def test_comments_and_blank_lines_ignored(self):
        self.assertIsNone(parse_dotenv_line("# comment"))
        self.assertIsNone(parse_dotenv_line(""))
        self.assertIsNone(parse_dotenv_line("   "))

    def test_exported_key_named_like_export_is_not_stripped(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_dotenv_line("exportX=1"), ("exportX", "1"))

    def test_load_config_from_file_with_mixed_syntax(self):
        path = write_env(
            "# header\n"
            "export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN=\"sk_test_1=2\"\n"
            "PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET='whsec_x'\n"
            "export PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT=https://e.example/?a=1&b=2\n"
            "PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=15\n"
        )
        try:
            config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=path)
        finally:
            os.remove(path)
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], ("sk_test_1=2", ".env"))
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET"], ("whsec_x", ".env"))
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"], ("https://e.example/?a=1&b=2", ".env"))
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT"], ("15", ".env"))


class DoctorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_report_shows_sources_and_redacts_secrets(self):
        path = write_env(
            'export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sk_live_SECRETVALUE123"\n'
            "PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=15\n"
        )
        try:
            report = doctor_report(
                environ={"PAYHOOK_REGION": "us", "PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET": "whsec_ENVSECRET999"},
                dotenv_path=path,
            )
        finally:
            os.remove(path)
        self.assertNotIn("SECRETVALUE123", report)
        self.assertNotIn("ENVSECRET999", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = 'us'  [source: env]", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT = '15'  [source: .env]", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.payments.example/v1'  [source: default]", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN = (set, redacted, 22 characters)  [source: .env]", report)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET = (set, redacted, 17 characters)  [source: env]", report)

    def test_unset_required_setting_is_reported_missing(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            report = doctor_report(environ={}, dotenv_path=os.path.join(tmp, ".env"))
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN = (not set)  [source: default]", report)
        self.assertIn("(not found)", report)
        self.assertIn("missing required settings: PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN, PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET", report)

    def test_cli_doctor_does_not_print_secret_from_env(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"],
                cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True,
                env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": ROOT, "PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN": "sk_live_CLISECRET77"},
            )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("CLISECRET77", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN = (set, redacted, 18 characters)  [source: env]", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
